general.title: Your Runbook Drifted Since the Last Incident: Audit Alert Names, Permissions, and Step Intent in CI
general.describe: Your Runbook Drifted Since the Last Incident: Audit Alert Names, Permissions, and Step Intent in CI A runbook rarely fails because the idea behind it was wrong; it fails because something around it moved while nobody was looking. The alert got renamed during a dashboard cleanup, the rotation lost a cluster role in a permissions refactor, or the prose says "restart the pod" while the command quietly deletes the deployment.
